canonical.title: The Last Tree on Earth
canonical.description:
A centuries-old tree witnesses the destruction of its forest home and the eventual restoration by a group of determined children.

Join Methuselah, Lily and Dr. Patel in this cinematic, emotional, hopeful, documentary-style story about Hope and Resilience in the Face of Environmental Degradation. Perfect for general audience, all ages.

Subscribe for more Hope and Resilience in the Face of Environmental Degradation stories.
